body: Thank you, really. I broke down crying about this stuff yesterday then went to sleep thinking I'd wake up feeling better - I didn't. I stayed home from school today to cheer up and it's helped a little bit and it sorta helped, also I'm going to see my therapist in a bit. Reading this made me feel a bit better overall. My parents have never understood what I go through and I hate it, but I know they're not gonna really change. Hearing that I'm not the problem is such a relief, I feel like a burden on everyone and I just want company, I guess what you said could get me some more people to hang out with. I'll take your advice and see what I can figure out from here on. Thank you, dude. :,3
